# Agent Skills Standards Comprehensive Documentation

## Project Status

✅ **COMPLETE** — Phase 1 & 2 documentation standards finalized and merged to develop branch.

## Overview

Comprehensive documentation standards for agent development across the organization. Establishes canonical standards for:

- Agent implementations (Claude, Copilot, OpenAI, Gemini)
- Skills architecture and organization
- Instruction files and governance
- Workflows and automation
- Plugins and reusable components

## Key Deliverables

- **9 Documentation Standards** — Complete specifications for agents, skills, instructions, workflows, plugins, and skills
- **9 Standards Documents** in `docs/` folder with detailed guidance
- **Schema Compliance** — All documentation follows frontmatter standards
- **Multi-provider Support** — Standards cover 4+ provider implementations
